items.description: Applauding the student protesters for “sustaining the struggle, despite heavy odds and police brutality”, the statement said this could be a “significant step” towards achieving meaningful education reforms in India

items.title: Supergroup humback whale sightings on the increase in South Africa
items.description: Together with dolphins, they are one of at least 37 species of marine mammals that can be found in South African waters.

items.title: British PM Rishi Sunak avoids wipeout in key local elections
items.description: By-elections were seen as an indicator of the two main parties' prospects at a time when voters are struggling with high inflation, strikes and rising mortgage rates.
